An Ethereal Evening with @dovecameron 🖤

A night in LA celebrating the launch of Curology x Dove Cameron and the debut of our Ethereal Glow Collection, surrounded by some of our favorite faces (and snakes). A first look inside the evening ✨

In case you missed it… Curology x Dove Cameron is officially here 🗞️

Get to know the Ethereal Glow Set everyone’s talking about, from the story behind it to the four new skincare and lip essentials ✨

Shop now exclusively at curology.com

An ethereal glow radiates from within. It’s light that’s nourished and embraced, crafted into layerable formulas for skin that feels soft and looks luminous.

A closer look at the Curology x Dove Cameron Ethereal Glow Set 🖤

After months of imagining it, @dovecameron finally got to hold the finished Ethereal Glow Collection IRL 🥹 Inspired by her own snake tattoos, Dove knew the creative world she wanted the collection to live in: ethereal with an edge, soft without feeling delicate, and rooted in transformation. 🐍

Meet the Curology x Dove Cameron Ethereal Glow Set ♡🕊️

Skincare that works hard and looks good doing it. Created in partnership with @dovecameron, these four essentials bring together Curology’s skincare expertise and Dove’s signature aesthetic, with hydrating, weightless formulas, skin-enhancing finishes, and packaging you’ll want to keep on display.

𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐮𝐩:
✧ Shed the Day Cleanser: A refreshing gel-to-foam cleanse
✧ Lethal Glow Moisturizer: Weightless hydration for luminous skin
✧ Ethereal Primer: A smooth, soft-focus finish
✧ Sugar Venom Lip Treatment: Nourishing, glass-like shine

Plus, the limited-edition Serpent Pouch, free when you start a new Curology prescription subscription with the Ethereal Glow Set, while supplies last.

Shop now at curology.com
